scripts.install:hc: bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh holochain $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_hc_version && bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh hc $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_hc_version && bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh kitsune2-bootstrap-srv $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_k2_version
scripts.build:all: npm run clean:hc & npm run build:happ && npm run build:bindings && npm run build:webcomponents && npm run build:playground
scripts.devtest: npm run build:all && npm run start:mem
scripts.new-sandbox:mem: RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=warn echo "pass" | $npm_package_config_bin/hc s --holochain-path $npm_package_config_bin/holochain --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT generate artifacts/tasker.happ --run=$HC_APP_PORT -a hTasker network mem
scripts.new-sandbox:local: RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=warn echo "pass" | $npm_package_config_bin/hc s --holochain-path $npm_package_config_bin/holochain --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT generate artifacts/tasker.happ --run=$HC_APP_PORT -a hTasker network --bootstrap http://127.0.0.1:$BOOT_PORT webrtc ws://127.0.0.1:$BOOT_PORT
scripts.start:local: FORCE_COLOR=0 UI_PORT=$(port) HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run _save-ports" "npm run new-sandbox:local" "sleep 5 && npm run start -w playground/webapp"
scripts.start:mem: FORCE_COLOR=0 UI_PORT=$(port) HC_APP_PORT=$(port) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(port) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run new-sandbox:mem" "sleep 5 && npm run start -w playground/webapp"
scripts.serve:save: echo SIGNAL_PORT=$SIGNAL_PORT && echo $SIGNAL_PORT > .hc_signalenv && echo $BOOT_PORT > .hc_bootenv && echo BOOT_PORT=$BOOT_PORT
scripts.network2: npm run build:all && FORCE_COLOR=0 BOOT_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run serve:save" "npm run serve:run" "INDEX=0 npm run start:local" "sleep 1 && INDEX=1 npm run start:local"
scripts.network3: npm run build:all && FORCE_COLOR=0 BOOT_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run serve:save" "npm run serve:run" "INDEX=0 npm run start:local" "sleep 1 && INDEX=1 npm run start:local" "sleep 2 && INDEX=2 npm run start:local"
scripts.network:we: npm run clean:hc & npm run network:local2 -w we-applet
scripts.local:sandbox: echo INDEX $INDEX & echo PORTS $BOOT_PORT $SIGNAL_PORT $HC_APP_PORT $HC_ADMIN_PORT & RUST_LOG=warn WASM_LOG=warn echo "pass" | $npm_package_config_bin/hc s --piped -f=$HC_ADMIN_PORT run $INDEX
scripts._local: BOOT_PORT=$(cat .hc_bootenv) SIGNAL_PORT=$(cat .hc_bootenv) HC_APP_PORT=$(cat .hc_app_$INDEX) HC_ADMIN_PORT=$(cat .hc_admin_$INDEX) HAPP_BUILD_MODE='Debug' concurrently "npm run local:sandbox" "sleep 7 && npm run start -w playground/webapp"
scripts.package: rm -rf ui.zip && cd dist && bestzip ../ui.zip * && cd .. && hc web-app pack ./webhapp.workdir
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:hc && npm run clean && npm run clean:npm
